prime_rule: No engine without purpose, boundaries, receipts, and authority.

engines.purpose: Gather approved source packets into the governed intake queue.
engines.authority_surface: n8n allowlisted source fetch plus restricted PostgreSQL intake functions
engines.promotion_next: Keep source registry, dedupe, review queue, and human admission path verified.

engines.purpose: Turn admitted evidence and portfolio context into governed assessment state.
engines.authority_surface: PostgreSQL policy ledger, append-only assessments, workbench and proposal queue
engines.promotion_next: Keep decision-grade valuation, cash, debt, reserve, overlap, and reviewer approval gates intact.

engines.purpose: Orchestrate intake, evidence, Decision Engine, capital controls, shadow observation, and Paper boundary.
engines.promotion_next: Maintain verified component count, workbench readback, and no live trading authority.

engines.purpose: Gate whether capital deployment is allowed after liquidity, reserve, debt, valuation, and overlap checks.
engines.authority_surface: capital posture, portfolio decision contexts, Decision Engine validation, Paper policy gates
engines.promotion_next: Keep distributed controls and regression receipts verified; a standalone deployment authority remains intentionally absent.

engines.purpose: Organize official-record signals, state lanes, research queues, and candidate review flow.
engines.promotion_next: Keep official-record-first source rules, lane validation, and human review gates visible.

engines.purpose: Manage consumer-sector review packets, sufficiency checks, monitoring-only statuses, and review completion.
engines.authority_surface: consumer review packet, completion, requirement, artifact, and dashboard views
engines.promotion_next: Preserve monitoring-only boundary and require human review before any action lane.

engines.purpose: Enforce cross-system authority, scope, boundaries, compliance tests, and promotion gates.
engines.authority_surface: broader Nexus Governance database and compliance records once explicitly mapped
forbidden: claiming formal governance from local safeguards alone
engines.promotion_next: Keep authority registry, boundary checks, and human-stop receipts verified; formal governance authority remains separately gated.

engines.purpose: Map raw signal context, environment/constraint relationships, and contextual routing.
engines.authority_surface: raw signal context and validation records if reactivated
engines.promotion_next: Keep context lineage, replay fingerprints, and downstream action stops verified; formal context authority remains separately gated.
